user.title: Heat pump installation
user.description: Name the installation and choose its modules.

reconfigure.title: Edit heat pump installation
reconfigure.description: Disabled modules keep their settings and return in observation mode when enabled again.

co.title: Space heating sources
co.description: Choose circuit sources and optional outputs. With valves, ensure a hydraulic flow path even when all zones are closed.

data.disconnect_demand: Explicitly detach the saved demand output

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: Separate multiple entity IDs with commas. NC energizes to open; NO energizes to close; polarity maps energized to the HA switch state.

group.title: Presentation group
group.description: A group has no target, sources, outputs or regulation weight.

dhw.title: Domestic hot water sources
dhw.description: This step only assigns sources; it does not create a temperature or schedule.

confirm.title: Confirm installation
confirm.description: Save {name} with {zones} heating zones. Saving does not send device commands.

detach_warning.title: Outputs will be detached
detach_warning.description: Current HA reports: {outputs}. The last device state remains unchanged and is not physical valve feedback. Change it manually if needed, then confirm.
